text: Based on the satellite fire-detection data from NASA FIRMS (using VIIRS and MODIS sensors), there were **no active fire or thermal anomalies detected** on or intersecting with the property (ASSET-F04) during the period **October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026**. All sensors had full coverage of the area for the entire period, confirming no burning occurred. The detection count for the asset was zero.
